title: CerebralHelm Workflow Definition
description: An ordered, linear, deterministic 1..N-step plan of tool invocations, resolved by the action planner (NIC-38). A quickAction id and a mode application both resolve to this same artifact; a single-step action is simply N=1. Step inputs are resolved statically (literal values and reference-catalog ids) and validated against each tool's input schema at resolve time. MVP scope is intentionally narrow: there is no data flow between steps (a step never consumes a prior step's output), and no branching, conditional, or model-driven steps. A capability a workflow lacks is added as a new tool, never as new planner logic.

input.description: Static input/reference bindings for this step. Deep validation is deferred to resolve time, where the planner checks this object against the step tool's input schema (descriptors authoritative). MVP: resolved only from literal values and reference-catalog ids, never from another step's output.
